title: Area of a Circle
description:
Given the radius r of a circle as an integer, output its area.

The area is pi * r^2 where pi = 3.141592653589793... Your answer is accepted if it is within 1e-4 of the true value, so you may print any reasonable number of decimal digits. This problem uses a Special Judge (SPJ) because many different numeric outputs are all correct.
input: A single integer r (1 <= r <= 10000) — the radius.
output: A single real number — the area of the circle. Any answer within 1e-4 of the exact value is accepted.
note: This problem is judged by a Special Judge (spj.cpp) that reads your output and checks |your_answer - pi*r^2| < 1e-4. Exact string matching is NOT used here.
